translations.web: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
translations.bsb: God called the light “day,” and the darkness He called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
translations.kjv: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
translations.asv: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.
